title: JSON Schema for an Office Add-in Action File
description: A file describing the data format for a single Office.js action referenced by an Office Add-in's actionFile property.

$schema.title: ActionSchema
$schema.description: The URI/URL of this schema, which should always be https://developer.microsoft.com/json-schemas/office-js/1.0/action.schema.json in a production app

id.title: Action ID
id.description: The ID of the action, which must match an action ID in the manifest.

actionDescription.title: Action Description
actionDescription.description: Describes what the action does and when to use it.

parameters.title: Parameters
parameters.description: The JSON Schema 2020-12 input schema for the action, following the MCP tool inputSchema shape. The root type must be 'object'.

type.title: Type
type.description: The JSON Schema type. Must be 'object'.

properties.title: Properties
properties.description: Maps parameter names to their definitions.

required.title: Required
required.description: The names of the required parameters.

additionalProperties.title: Additional Properties
additionalProperties.description: A schema for parameters not listed in 'properties', or a boolean indicating whether they are allowed.

returns.title: Returns
returns.description: The JSON Schema 2020-12 output schema for the action, following the MCP tool outputSchema shape.

type.title: Type
type.description: The type of the returned value or values.

properties.title: Properties
properties.description: Maps returned property names to their definitions.

required.title: Required
required.description: The names of the required returned properties.

additionalProperties.title: Additional Properties
additionalProperties.description: A schema for returned properties not listed in 'properties', or a boolean indicating whether they are allowed.

description.title: Description
description.description: A description of the returned value.
